name: multiply by the matrix repeatedly and renormalise
mechanism: apply the matrix to a vector, rescale to unit length, and repeat; the component along the dominant eigenvector grows fastest, so the vector converges to it and the growth factor to its eigenvalue

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Power iteration' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Linear algebra:

fails_when: slow when the two largest eigenvalues are close; finds only the dominant one
